rules.title: File could not be parsed
rules.description: The file could not be parsed as JavaScript/JSX, so it cannot be analysed or rewritten automatically.

rules.title: Class component
rules.description: Class components should become function components with hooks. Simple render-only classes are converted automatically; classes with state or lifecycle methods need a human.

rules.title: Lifecycle method -> useEffect
rules.description: componentDidMount / componentDidUpdate / componentWillUnmount map to useEffect, but the dependency array and cleanup must be designed by hand.

rules.title: Unsafe legacy lifecycle
rules.description: componentWillMount / componentWillReceiveProps / componentWillUpdate (and UNSAFE_ variants) are deprecated and unsafe with concurrent rendering. They usually need a redesign (derived state, effects, or memoisation).

rules.title: defaultProps on a function component
rules.description: `Comp.defaultProps = {...}` is deprecated for function components (removed in React 19). Use default values in the destructured props parameter.

rules.title: PropTypes runtime checking
rules.description: PropTypes are ignored by React 19 and are better expressed as TypeScript types. Migrating to TypeScript is a project-level decision, so this is flagged for review with a suggested interface.
